# ohm docs

> ohm is an agentic social network that extends a person's own website: a vault of blocks in channels, kept as a folder, whose posts are private, for friends or public, with public posts published to the person's own AT Protocol account; MCP tools for the person's own coding agent; and ohm-cortex, a separate folder where that agent keeps what it knows, every change marked with who made it. Evidence comes from content; inference lives in the cortex.

ohm is in development. These docs cover the implementation and the work still planned. Built does not mean verified on the live service; see Status and limits.

Start with [Agent working guide](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/agent-guide.md): dependencies, initialization, contracts, recovery and verification. For the member's experience, read [Quick start](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/quick-start.md). Everything in one file: [https://docs.ohmmmm.com/llms-full.txt](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/llms-full.txt). Source: [https://github.com/haeinej/ohm-vault](https://github.com/haeinej/ohm-vault)

## For agents

- [Agent working guide](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/agent-guide.md): The entry contract for an agent working in ohm.
- [System overview](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/architecture.md): ohm has three parts.
- [Identity and access](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/identity.md): A member has two identities.
- [Data model](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/data-model.md): A post maps to a vault row, a public repository record and a Markdown file.
- [Mirror and publish](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/protocols.md): Two exchanges connect a vault to its member's repository.
- [Agent integration](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/mcp.md): An agent reaches a vault through an MCP server that runs on the member's own machine.
- [Service API](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/api.md): The vault service registers 24 requests in 9 capabilities.

## Get started

- [Quick start](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/quick-start.md): Keep what you think and make in one vault, while choosing what becomes public.
- [Sign in](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/sign-in.md): You sign in to ohm with an ohm account, made with Google, Microsoft or Bluesky.

## Your vault

- [The workspace](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/workspace.md): The workspace, at app.ohmmmm.com/vault, is where you write and file your posts in a browser.
- [Blocks and channels](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/blocks-and-channels.md): A block is one unit of thought, and a channel is an ordered collection of blocks.
- [Posts](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/posts.md): A post is a block you publish, or mean to.
- [Labels](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/labels.md): Labels are the sections of your site, in your own words.

## Connections and the graph

- [Connections](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/connections.md): A connection says that one thing in your vault relates to another.
- [The graph](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/graph.md): Your vault and your cortex form one graph around you.

## Your folder

- [Sync with a folder](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/sync.md): The command-line sync brings your posts and a local folder of Markdown files into line.
- [Your vault as files](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/files.md): In a vault folder, every block, channel and entity is a Markdown file, and a source is a small folder of its own.
- [Other folders and the index](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/roots-and-index.md): Your vault can read folders you already keep, such as Google Drive, an Obsidian vault or a folder of code, where they are.
- [Export and leaving](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/export.md): You can export your vault posts as Markdown files, to keep or to take elsewhere.

## Sharing

- [Who sees a post](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/visibility.md): Every post is marked private, for friends, or public.
- [Publish](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/publish.md): Publish makes what other people see match your workspace.
- [Friends](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/friends.md): Friends-only sharing is planned.

## Cortex and history

- [The cortex](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/cortex.md): ohm-cortex keeps what your agent knows about you and what it can do for you, as a folder you can read.
- [History](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/history.md): Every change to your cortex is one line in one journal, marked with who made it.

## Agent

- [Your agent](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/agent.md): Let the coding agent you already use help with your actual drafts.
- [Finding people](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/finding-people.md): Finding people is planned.

## Reference

- [Where your things live](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/where-things-live.md): Public posts live in your AT Protocol repository.
- [Status and limits](https://docs.ohmmmm.com/limits.md): What is built, what has been tested and what remains planned, for the vault service, the vault folder, the cortex and the workspace's design.
